args.sql:
WITH RankedEquipment AS (
    SELECT 
        equipmenttype, 
        equipmentcode, 
        efficiencyindex AS overall_efficiency, 
        safetyindex, 
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY efficiencyindex) AS efficiency_rank, 
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY safetyindex) AS safety_rank, 
        (RANK() OVER (ORDER BY efficiencyindex)) - (RANK() OVER (ORDER BY safetyindex)) AS rank_difference
    FROM 
        equipment
)
SELECT 
    equipmenttype, 
    equipmentcode, 
    overall_efficiency, 
    safetyindex, 
    efficiency_rank, 
    safety_rank, 
    rank_difference
FROM 
    RankedEquipment
ORDER BY 
    rank_difference;
